text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... They got away from 
me, darn it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's strong...! No matter how much I 
contest her, I can't reach her. This sheer 
depth of hers is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The fated showdown is settled! This year's 
Arima Kinen winner is—Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did it~...!! I'm the Grand 
Prix winner! And...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you are a Grand Prix Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine, thank you so 
much... I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come... let's head to the winner's circle 
together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone. It's Super Creek, former 
villainessâª

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I'm just an older 
sister Umamusume who wants to pamper her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Pamper me too, please.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I care deeply about every single one 
of you, too. So, are you ready~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please be careful on your way home. 
Remember, the "Arima Kinen" isn't over 
until you're back in your house, okay?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A completely unified response. It seems 
Super Creek has completely won their 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then lastly, please let me give you a very 
special celebration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"To my Trainer who became number one in 
the world, I'd like to give you a reward 
and my thanks."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brought out from a step back, right into 
the spotlight in front of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've truly become so 
dependable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to achieve 
wonderful results over these past three 
years.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, my career isn't just about 
finishing order.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer standing right here is 
everything that I—that we have built 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding back the tears welling up in her 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Very well done~. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Closing my eyes and letting it happen. 
Getting headpats at the very top feels 
exceptional. And—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I had no idea what was 
happening. My body was enveloped in 
something warm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Held tightly in Super Creek's arms, I 
looked up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very, very much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for meeting me. Meeting you, 
Trainer... is my everything...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her body trembling, unable even to return 
the embrace, she keeps looking up at the 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Trainer. The sky that felt 
endlessly far away that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now, scooped up in Super Creek's arms— we 
are so close.
